messages:
Rae Thornton: Rapid sync - final social plan for 'Inference at Scale' webinar. Need: X thread (4 tweets), LinkedIn single image + 3-card carousel, 18s teaser, and HubSpot routing with variant tags. Can we lock copy + owners by noon?

Miles Kim: I got copy. Proposed post cadence: X -> Tue 11:00am PT, LinkedIn -> Wed 10:00am PT. UTM template: utm_source=social&utm_medium=organic&utm_campaign=inference_scale_q2. Example: ?utm_source=x_social&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=inference_scale_q2&utm_content=variantA

Sophie L: Assets note: I have 18s teaser & carousel comps. Need final hero headline and speaker one-liners for slide1. Also we should burn captions for LI autoplay.

Anton V: Ill do lead routing. Plan: HubSpot form -> list 'IA_Scale_Q2'. Tag leads with source_social and variant=A/B. Registrants who attend -> set SFDC Lead.Status = 'Webinar - Attended' and auto-create a high-priority SDR task. I'll share the HS export.

Miles Kim: Draft X thread (compact):
1) "Inference at scale: engineering patterns we actually use. 1/4"
2) "Batching + prefix caching to cut cost without latency tradeoffs. 2/4"
3A) "Tune for latency (SLO-first)." 3B) "Tune for unit cost (40% savings)."
4) "Register: short.link/inference?utm_campaign=inference_scale_q2&utm_content=variantA"

Sophie L: Uploaded teaser + PNGs to Drive (link). Exported 1080x1080 & 1200x675. Added a variant of carousel that leads with outcome vs technical lead.

leadflow-bot: Workflow created: HubSpot list 'IA_Scale_Q2' and draft automation (confirmation email + calendar invite).

Rae Thornton: A/B plan: X tweet #3 will be split tech vs outcome. Label links variantA/variantB; tag leads accordingly. Miles, please add both CTAs to the copy doc so we can switch quickly.

Miles Kim: Done. Pasting final copy doc and short links. Also adding speaker handles inline for X.

Anton V: HubSpot checklist I will implement: 1) form -> add to 'IA_Scale_Q2' 2) confirmation email + calendar invite 3) attended -> SFDC update + SDR task 4) add tags: source_social, variantA/B 5) add leadnote with originating post id. Sharing HS workflow export for review in 30m.

Sophie L: Design note: first carousel card = headline + speaker 1-liners, last card = CTA + short link + UTM. Teaser will have burned captions and a subtle logo lower-left.

Rae Thornton: Owners: Copy + AB variants: Miles. Assets + exports: Sophie. Scheduling + calendar: Rae. HubSpot + routing: Anton. React with :thumbsup: if good.

Miles Kim: :thumbsup:

Sophie L: :thumbsup:

Anton V: :thumbsup:

Rae Thornton: Thanks all  Ill drop final links in #marketing-ops before scheduling.
